claim: Proposal ec_prison_door_unlocked: The prison door of Edward's Castle (scene $0B) was unlocked with the Prison Key; event block $06 (layer 1) is applied on later loads.

trial.control: load scene $0B with flag $0106 clear and record mapLayerTilemap ($7EA000) and collisionLayer ($7FC000) rectangle 2x2 metatiles at (0E,10)
trial.forced: set flag $0106 (byte $0A20 bit 6) and load the same scene again
observe: mapLayerTilemap ($7EA000) and collisionLayer ($7FC000) rectangle 2x2 metatiles at (0E,10)

confirms: the rectangle shows the copy of the source rectangle (1E,2E) only in the forced load; with the real setter played in the story the same picture appears
refutes: the rectangle is unchanged in the forced load, or a second setter exists
